observations.text: Crossing washes joined pale lanes in the violet field; folds stayed faint.
Long brass gestures formed a heart but left an interior violet slit.
Two broad crossings closed the slit; densely sampled steel arch reserved a smooth violet opening.
Loaded warm plane became clearer; outlined keyhole retained two pinholes.
Dark crossings filled both pinholes. Steel reflections stayed cooler than brass.
Dark sockets and warm lips seated steel legs, but lips were too regular.
Single loaded shoulder fleck remained visible in whole view.
Sampled small key bow remained open; unequal teeth added. Upper pan confirmed smooth shackle crown.
Broad warm neighbors shortened dark right band but flattened the keyhole cap and retained relief.
Offset crescents turned rivets; socket covers shortened color without removing relief.
Thin patina marks became rails rather than irregular stains.
Broader neighbors shortened rails but made raised warm patches.
Broad watercolor contacts joined soft shadows without opaque feet; lower/right pan showed clean key bow and thin prong teeth.
Loaded bases made key teeth more solid while remaining subordinate.
Reflection ends shortened and lower shadow rail softened; brass flecks remained.

Final keyhole cap/patch-end/bow-light refinement had diminishing returns. Smooth reserved openings and compact reflection survived; faceted lobes, slightly flat keyhole cap, regular bristles and raised repairs remained.
